repository_summary: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is an open-source C++ library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel. It provides an Aspose.Cells-compatible API surface, supports .xlsx load/save from file paths and streams, and includes features like cell values, formulas, styles, conditional formatting, and more. The library is MIT-licensed and available via NuGet as Aspose.cells.Cpp.FOSS, with CMake-based build and installation.
